items.text: The source confirms the issue: `inputHandleBlur` dispatches `selectItem: true` without looking at the blur event. I’ll preserve the existing mouse/touch tracker behavior and make keyboard/real-focus transfers select only when `relatedTarget` exists, adding focused tests beside the current blur coverage.

The blur handler now derives selection from `event.relatedTarget`: null closes without selection, while an actual next focused element keeps the established selection behavior. The regression test uses the same null-target shape produced when focus leaves the document.

items.text:
Fixed `useCombobox` input blur behavior.

The blur handler now selects the highlighted item only when `event.relatedTarget` identifies a new focused element. A null `relatedTarget` closes the menu without changing selection, covering browser tab/window switches.

Added regression coverage in [getInputProps.test.js](/home/sandbox/workspace/src/hooks/useCombobox/__tests__/getInputProps.test.js:1360).

Verified with:

```sh
npx kcd-scripts test --no-watch src/hooks/useCombobox/__tests__/getInputProps.test.js
```
